# External Image Provenance

These files were downloaded from Wikimedia Commons on 24 October 2026. The visible captions in `primer_fluid_mechanics.md` give each credit, source page, and licence link. The local JPEGs preserve the Commons pixel data; no resizing, cropping, or recompression was applied. The T-38 file's invalid 1 × 1 DPI metadata was normalised to 96 DPI so XeLaTeX can place it safely in the PDF.
